options.label: WikiArt color reproduction
options.description: Full-color reproduction with brighter red clothing and warmer, lighter table and floor details than the museum option.
options.credit: Jan Matejko / National Museum in Warsaw; published by WikiArt, which credits the Wikimedia museum image as its source.
options.altText: Complete Stańczyk painting, with the seated red-clothed jester, papers on the table and court festivities at right.
options.license: WikiArt marks the painting public domain. Rights and reuse terms for the published reproduction remain pending app clearance.
options.sourceNotes: The public WikiArt artwork page supplies this 2464 × 1832 reproduction and identifies the 1862 National Museum in Warsaw painting. Its source link points to https://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plik:Jan_Matejko,_Sta%C5%84czyk.jpg . It appears derived from the same museum capture as A, with a visibly brighter and warmer existing rendering. It is not claimed to be an independent photograph or a more color-accurate image. The full source file was downloaded unchanged; no grading, cropping or sharpening was applied for this review.
